run_detection_evaluation: run the EgoMQ detection evaluation pipeline on the ego4d test or validation split
run_retrieval_evaluation: run the EgoMQ retrieval evaluation pipeline on the ego4d test or validation split
run_all_evaluation: run both detection and retrieval evaluation stages using eval_stage set to all
generate_detections: generate multicore detection predictions for the ego4d dataset using the Eval entry point
generate_retrieval: generate multicore retrieval predictions for the ego4d dataset using the Eval entry point
